<tbody><tr><td>

[TerminalResources](./terminal_contract.terminalresources.md)

</td><td>

The type of the resource table in `terminalContract` (the app's `/contract` entry): every resource a reference can name, keyed by manifest resource key, with its record type, its identifier type (when it has one), the operations that resolve references to it, and, for each of those operations that finds the resource only within another resource, that parent. A client created from the contract carries it, so `bindReference` admits only references the contract can resolve.

</td></tr>
